verdict.rationale: Windows is an OS, so installing it on a machine is a fair question. The only relevant evidence is a community comment describing how to get through Windows setup and create a local account, which implies an installation flow exists. A PC Health Check app is also mentioned, but its purpose is not described. Nothing documents replacing a different existing OS on the same machine. Missing for 10: first-party installation or clean-install documentation, install media and boot instructions, guidance on replacing a non-Windows OS (wiping or partitioning the existing install), documented hardware compatibility checks, and hands-on confirmation of a full replacement install.
